shared_elements: elaborate tiered curled hair/wig with rows of curls
shallow bowl or cup held raised in one hand
arm bent at elbow with hand extended
long belted robe with patterned/fringed edge
low-relief figures aligned in a horizontal register
hands rendered with prominent parallel fingers
justification: Both show the same very specific figure type: a bearded male in strict profile with a stepped mass of tight curls for hair and beard, wearing a long belted robe and raising a shallow bowl in a bent arm, carved in shallow relief along a horizontal register. The chief difference in content is the composition: A is a confronted pair of large principal figures with attendants and a band of inscribed writing running across the garments, whereas B is a repetitive unidirectional file of near-identical smaller bowl-bearers with no inscription.
